#!/usr/bin/env bash
# awsp: pick profile + region via fzf, auto sso login
set -euo pipefail

profile=$(aws configure list-profiles | fzf --prompt="profile> " --height=40%)
[ -z "$profile" ] && exit 0

export AWS_PROFILE="$profile"

if ! aws sts get-caller-identity >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "sso login needed for $profile"
  aws sso login --profile "$profile"
fi

region=$(aws configure get region --profile "$profile" || echo us-east-1)
echo "export AWS_PROFILE=$profile"
echo "export AWS_REGION=$region"
aws sts get-caller-identity
summary_zh: AWS profile fzf 切換並自動 sso login
